sentences.text:
-1- 
 High Court Of Chhattisgarh, Bilaspur
 Order Sheet

Wpc No. 1123 of 2022
 Sushil Agrawal Versus South Eastern Coal Fields Limited
10/07/2023 Ms. Sameeksha Gupta, counsel for the petitioner.
 Mr. Vinod Deshmukh, counsel for respondents No. 1 &
2/Secl.
Mr. Aditya Tiwari, Panel Lawyer for the State.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the land of the petitioner situated at Village- Kurja, Tehsil- Kotma, District- Anuppur (MP) was acquired by respondents No. 1 & 2 under the Coal Bearing Areas (Acquisition and Development)
Act, 1957.

entities.text:
Coal Bearing Areas (Acquisition and Development)
Act, 1957
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Respondents-SECL have also deposited amount of compensation of land acquired before respondent No.3 (Part Time Tribunal).

In the proceedings of disbursement of amount, respondents -SECL submitted an application under Order 6 Rule 17 of the CPC that some Civil Suit is pending between Gaya Prasad and Ors. Vs. Ramanand Pandey and Ors.

entities.text: Gaya Prasad and Ors. Vs. Ramanand Pandey and Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: in the Court of Civil Judge Class-II Kotma, District- Anuppur and after death of Gaya Prasad Pandey, his legal heir/heirs are necessary party.

entities.text: Civil Judge Class-II Kotma, District- Anuppur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The said application was allowed by the impugned order and the petitioner was directed to implead the person named in the application as non applicant No. 2 and also notices to be issued intimating that amount of compensation is deposited.

When the question is put to learned counsel for respondents No 1 & 2/SECL as to how they came to know about pendency of Civil Suit or any claim made by any other person on the subject land, he submits that in the reply filed, there is no specific pleading in this regard and prays for a short time.
As prayed by learned counsel for respondents -SECL, list this case in the week after next.

On the said date, respondents No.1 & 2/SECL, shall place on record the relevant documents as to on what basis or objection by any other party, they have filed an application for amendment before the respondent No.3/ Part Time Tribunal.
Certified copy of the order today.
Sd/-/-/----/---/-------/--/-
